hypothesis: Allowing the inert /dev/null device through the bounded macOS write profile restores Git and package-wrapper startup without widening repository or authority writes.

metricsCompared.name: bounded macOS profile permits required Git sink

rationale: The baseline builder could not stage because Git opens /dev/null while sanitizing descriptors. The candidate adds one literal inert device allowance, retains the global write deny plus authority and Git-metadata protections, and passes the focused profile test. The next builder launch is the live canary because an already-running sandbox cannot adopt a revised profile.
